dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged-edged light perimeters forming closed 'O' and open 'C' shapes across the dorsal-lateral midsection, exhibiting sharp contrast boundaries between the light ring and the dark coat.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of clustered light-intensity pixel groups on the lower neck and shoulder region; lower density, more isolated light blobs on the lower posterior flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of three prominent mid-dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle; these relate to the shoulder blob cluster through a roughly linear horizontal alignment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single high-intensity circular white mark located on the posterior-lateral flank, superior to the hind flipper base.
other_distinctive_markers: Branching, dendritic-like light patterns on the posterior mid-flank where multiple annuli appear to merge or connect.
